text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Incredible!?
The swooping 'Phantom Bird' leaps triumphantly into the fray!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
This year's Derby Umamusume is
El Condor Pasa!!
It's El Condor Pasa!!
(UOOOOOOOOOH!!)

Her victory was proclaimed far and wide.
El Condor Pasa had claimed the crown, and yet...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Haa, haa... *gasp*, *wheeze*, *cough*...
*cough*, *cough-cough*...!

A look of sheer desperation like never before.
It hardly seemed like the face of someone who had conquered the Derby.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Trainer... Thank you... desu...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Still... but...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
There wasn't any gap at all...
If I let my guard down for even a second...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: To think Spe-chan is that much...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
El-chan, congratulations...!
I'm so frustrated, though~!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Still, that's what happens when you give it your all, right?
Ehehe, ehehehe...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Spe-chan, why...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Why are you this strong...? Just when
did you acquire such power, *yes*?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Huh? All I did was train my hardest,
nothing particularly special...

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah, but if I lose to El-chan, I feel like
everyone who trained with me loses too.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Maybe having that is why I was able to run this far!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Everyone... that I've come this far with...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Is zat... so...?

"Leaving the victory party early,
El Condor Pasa sat sulking in the park..."
I watched from a distance as Grass Wonder encouraged El Condor Pasa.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
El, pull yourself together. You won,
so you should take pride in that.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Y-Yeah……

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: This is quite a problem...

Looking utterly at a loss, Grass Wonder
walked over to me.
choice_data_list: Is it rare for things to turn out like this?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
...Yes.
She's always so bold and confident, after all.

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"More than the result itself... she was probably surprised
at the lack of a tangible gap in their abilities."

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Because she knows no stumbling,
the impact when she finally does stumble will be...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
can I leave the rest to you?

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Of course I'm worried.
Even so...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Because we're in the same boat, there are things we cannot share.
Things that must never be shared...

text_block_list.name: Grass Wonder
text_block_list.text: So... please, I beg of you.

Grass Wonder gave a slight bow
and took her leave.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Trainer... El is...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: Was I... getting ahead of myself?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"I thought I could run with so much more ease.
If El truly aims to be the world's strongest, that is..."

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
I didn't have any breathing room at all though.
Spe-chan has gotten so incredibly strong...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Here I am talking about taking on the world, but
could it be that I'm actually...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Did you just take the easy way out
without competing against your peers, desu ka?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: If that's the case...

A single match alone reveals nothing.
How should I interpret today's race?

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Still, I... won!
Which means... which means, I'm the strongest in the world!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
As long as I'm wearing this mask,
there's nothing to be afraid of... I hope!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: And so, our next target race is—

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text: "Japan Cu...p! Kuu...!"
She can't make the declaration. Hovering between her pride and reality, El Condor Pasa remains suspended in midair.

Pushing through like this is simply impossible.
In that case, it might be better to add
one more step beforehand.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
"The Mainichi Okan...? If I recall,
that's right before the autumn GⅠs..."

An autumn GⅠ trial race.
An 1,800m contest featuring senior-class competitors as well.

From here, we can naturally head to the Japan Cup,
as well as the Kikuka Sho for the Triple Crown, or the Mile Championship.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
It's a bit... like running away, isn't it.
But...

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Understood. For now, there...
I want to think about lots of things before autumn comes, yes...

A mask beginning to slip... The clearly visible
path to becoming the world's strongest wavered for the very first time.
